title: A Conversation with James Gorman, Chairman & CEO of Morgan Stanley
description: James Gorman, Chairman and CEO of Morgan Stanley, joined Professor Charles Murphy for a conversation with NYU Stern students, faculty and alumni on October 8, 2015
